content.text: LocalTime has no day of the year; time::day_of_year makes it from the date. Fixing that.
Built. Opening it from the tools menu on the X4.

Your plugin is in the reader: Quote of the day, in the tools menu, with a star. It shows one of seven short quotes about reading, a new one each day (the day of the year picks it), and OK or back closes it. It has German too. Say if you'd like other quotes, more of them, or the quote on the home screen as a widget.
